reuse.why: Introduces one shared getMonthActionCategories and routes all month-wide actions through it instead of adding the rule to each query.

duplication.why: Removes three copied category queries; the per-action income/tracking check stays repeated at each site, as before.

placement.why: The selection lives in budget/actions.ts beside getBudgetData, where the actions' DB reads already are.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and tests for them are touched; single-category actions are left alone.

maintainability.why: Clear single selection with a comment; copyPreviousMonth combines its own budget rows with an id set, slightly indirect but understandable.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action now uses getMonthActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplicated queries were removed rather than reshaped.

one_place.where: getMonthActionCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg.
